lane: Content + AI runtime knowledge brief: Vận 9 in the Kinh Dịch persona (plan B, batch 1 of docs/proposals/NEW_REFLECTION_MODALITIES_2026-11-27.vi.md, Owner approved 27/11/2026)
goal: Teach the Kinh Dịch book persona to explain Vận 9 (Tam Nguyên Cửu Vận, Huyền Không Phi Tinh) as a cultural origin that is not part of the Kinh Dịch text, relate it to hexagram 30 Ly in Nilaza's own words, end with a reflective question, and keep refusing every prediction (careers, money, house direction, lucky colours, mệnh, dates, ages, fortune). Add 4 eval questions and regenerate the bundled brief.
successCriteria: kinh-dich.vi.md has a new subsection 'Vận 9: giải thích, không dự đoán' inside sections 2-9 so it is bundled for the model: origin, 180-year cycle and 20-year vận, vận 9 from Lập Xuân 4/2/2024 to 2043, Cửu Tử, Ly, Nam; what the Kinh Dịch text says about quẻ 30 Ly in Nilaza's own wording; boundary; three reflective questions.

The out-of-scope rule in section 8 is changed so that questions about Vận 9, Tam Nguyên Cửu Vận and quẻ Ly are explained as culture and reflected through quẻ Ly while every prediction is still refused; the other refusal rules (dates, ages, fortune, feng-shui advice, role of a feng-shui master) are unchanged.
The 4 eval questions are added to the brief's eval list (section 10) and evalQuestionCount in index.json is 24.

npm run knowledge:briefs:generate rewrites supabase/functions/_shared/knowledge-briefs.generated.ts; knowledge:briefs:check, validate:backend, council:contract:check, validate:data pass; Deno tests that touch briefs pass.
No translation text is copied from a copyrighted edition; no prediction wording is introduced.
untouchedSurfaces: No Edge Function deploy, SQL, secret, Admin or app code change; the brief only takes effect after the Owner approves a separate ai-persona-chat deploy.
The other four knowledge briefs and the persona catalogue are unchanged.
PLAN.md is left to the integrating session.
